description: A client-placed `!` function whose two server calls are split by a browser statement (a `<host>` binding call): E-TX-CLIENT-MULTI-CALL at that statement (the permanent residue — the calls would be two requests).
rationale: S474 (user-voice-scrml.md, the four one-way doors, door 2): "F11 becomes INTERIM: a client `!`'s server calls compose into one request with one envelope … Only calls separated by browser work that cannot move stay refused." §19.9.9.8 rule 3: "A statement that needs the browser … SHALL NOT be relocated".
